name: OLMo 2 1B
notes: ARCHITECTURE CORRECTION worth recording: OLMo-2 1B and 7B are DENSE, not MoE. config.json is model_type 'olmo2' with 16 layers, hidden 2048, num_attention_heads 16 = num_key_value_heads 16, and NO num_experts / num_local_experts / experts_per_token keys and no MoE architecture string. The MoE variants of OLMo-2 are the 32B and 64B (allenai/OLMo-2-0325-32B: 64 layers, hidden 5120, 40 query / 8 KV heads) — the 1B and 7B are not. Anyone budgeting VRAM from a 'OLMo-2 is MoE' assumption is wrong on exactly the models that fit on a laptop. head_dim derived = 2048 / 16 = 128. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 16 * 16 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 131072 bytes/token at bf16 — identical to Phi-4-mini-instruct despite this model being less than half its size, because MHA at 16 heads costs as much as GQA at 8 heads with a double head_dim. At OLMo-2's native 4096 context that is 512 MiB of KV per sequence, comfortable; the same shape at 32k would be 4 GiB. 4096 context is genuinely the limit here (rope_scaling null, no extension), unlike the 128k Phi-4 mini. vocab 100352, intermediate 8192, rope_theta 500000, untied embeddings. Repo default torch_dtype is float32 — quantized at load, not bf16. Apache-2.0, fully open: GGUF and ONNX ports both exist (allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct-GGUF, liodon-ai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-ONNX).
